mapper.select: SELECT /* selectCurrentEvent */ EVENT_ID , EVENT_NM AS eventName , DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_STRT_DT, '%Y%m%d') AS eventStartDate , DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_END_DT, '%Y%m%d') AS eventEndDate , DISP_CNTS AS dispContents FROM TB_RLT_EVENT_M WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_STRT_DT, '%Y%m%d') <= #{todayYmd} AND #{todayYmd} <= DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_END_DT, '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY EVENT_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT /* selectLatestEvent */ EVENT_ID , EVENT_NM AS eventName , DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_STRT_DT, '%Y%m%d') AS eventStartDate , DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_END_DT, '%Y%m%d') AS eventEndDate , DISP_CNTS AS dispContents FROM TB_RLT_EVENT_M WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY EVENT_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT /* selectEventList */ EVENT_ID , EVENT_NM AS eventName , DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_STRT_DT, '%Y%m%d') AS eventStartDate , DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_END_DT, '%Y%m%d') AS eventEndDate , DISP_CNTS AS dispContents FROM TB_RLT_EVENT_M WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY EVENT_ID DESC

SELECT /* selectPrizeListByEventId */ PRIZE_ID , EVENT_ID , COUPON_NM AS couponName , COUPON_CD AS couponCode , WINNING_RATE AS winningRate , WIN_PRIZE_YN AS winningPrizeYn FROM TB_RLT_EVENT_PRIZE_M WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD ASC, PRIZE_ID ASC
SELECT /* selectAcntNoByUsrIdAndEventId */ ACNT_NO FROM TB_RLT_EVENT_TARGET_F WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND USR_ID = #{usrId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT /* selectAnyAcntNoByUsrId */ ACNT_NO FROM TB_RLT_EVENT_TARGET_F WHERE USR_ID = #{usrId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY TARGET_ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT /* selectTargetYn */ IS_TARGET_YN FROM TB_RLT_EVENT_TARGET_F WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND ACNT_NO = #{acntNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT /* upsertDefaultTarget */ INTO TB_RLT_EVENT_TARGET_F ( EVENT_ID , ACNT_NO , USR_ID , IS_TARGET_YN , TARGET_COUPON_NM , USE_YN , FST_REG_DTM , FST_REG_ID , LST_CHG_DTM , LST_CHG_ID ) VALUES ( #{eventId} , #{acntNo} , NULL , 'Y' , NULL , 'Y' , NOW() , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() , 'SYSTEM' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE IS_TARGET_YN = 'Y' , USE_YN = 'Y' , LST_CHG_DTM = NOW() , LST_CHG_ID = 'SYSTEM'
mapper.select: SELECT /* selectTargetCouponName */ TARGET_COUPON_NM FROM TB_RLT_EVENT_TARGET_F WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND ACNT_NO = #{acntNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT /* selectRaffleTicketCount */ RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT FROM TB_RLT_RAFFLE_BAL_F WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND ACNT_NO = #{acntNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT /* upsertDefaultRaffleBalance */ INTO TB_RLT_RAFFLE_BAL_F ( EVENT_ID , ACNT_NO , RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT , USE_YN , FST_REG_DTM , FST_REG_ID , LST_CHG_DTM , LST_CHG_ID ) VALUES ( #{eventId} , #{acntNo} , 3 , 'Y' , NOW() , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() , 'SYSTEM' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT = CASE WHEN RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT < 3 THEN 3 ELSE RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT END , USE_YN = 'Y' , LST_CHG_DTM = NOW() , LST_CHG_ID = 'SYSTEM'
mapper.update: UPDATE /* incrementRaffleTicketCount */ TB_RLT_RAFFLE_BAL_F SET RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT = RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT + 1 , LST_CHG_DTM = NOW() , LST_CHG_ID = 'SYSTEM' WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND ACNT_NO = #{acntNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

UPDATE /* decrementRaffleTicketCount */ TB_RLT_RAFFLE_BAL_F SET RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT = RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT - 1 , LST_CHG_DTM = NOW() , LST_CHG_ID = 'SYSTEM' WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND ACNT_NO = #{acntNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND RAFFLE_TICKET_CNT > 0
